title: assay.ledger-command/1
description: One line of a command file `commands/<repo_id>/<pr>.jsonl` in the ledger repository (docs/architecture/06-operations.md §1, 05-security.md T21, 03-contracts.md §6c), appended by decide-only from the triggering `issue_comment.created` payload. One record per `comment_id`; `run_uid.repo_id` and `pr` are the file's. Unknown fields are rejected.

head_sha.description: The PR head the comment was posted on: a head-bound command (waive, override, retry, weigh-in-ack) applies to that head alone (04-pipeline.md §5).

command.description: The command as its canonical line: `/assay`, a command word other than `recheck` (never recorded), then each argument after one space, at most 512 characters without a control character. The schema checks the prefix and the word; the reader also re-parses the line by the grammar of 04 §6 and refuses it unless it is that command's canonical line byte for byte.

body_sha256.description: The sha256 of the comment body at `created`: a body with another hash later voids the record (T21).

time.description: A UTC instant to the millisecond, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.
